title: Amplitude Modulation and Demodulation
short_description: Transistor-based low-level AM modulator and diode envelope detector, designed, simulated in Proteus, and built on Veroboard.
long_description: Communication Systems lab project (UET Taxila) implementing amplitude modulation and demodulation. A message signal (audio-frequency, ~500 Hz-1 kHz) modulates a carrier (~10-15 kHz) using a BC107BP transistor modulator with an LC tank circuit, then recovers the message using a diode (1N4007) envelope detector. Verified in Proteus with both function-generator and live audio-file sources, and physically implemented on a Veroboard using discrete components and a microphone input.

title: Android Controlled RC Car with Obstacle Distance Measurement
url_status: PENDING - need the exact GitHub repo link to confirm
short_description: Bluetooth-controlled RC car on a PIC16F877A, steered from an Android phone, with real-time ultrasonic obstacle-distance readout on an LCD.
long_description: Microprocessors and Microcontrollers lab project (UET Taxila) built around a PIC16F877A. An HC-06 Bluetooth module receives single-character drive commands over UART from an Android app and maps them to an L298N dual H-bridge motor driver for 8-direction movement. An HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor continuously measures obstacle distance via Timer1 pulse-width timing, displayed live on a 16x2 LCD. Designed and simulated in Proteus; firmware written in MikroC for PIC.

title: Pulse Sensor using Arduino UNO
short_description: Photoplethysmogram (PPG) heart-rate monitor using a Pulse Sensor Amped and Arduino Uno, with live BPM on an I2C LCD and serial monitor.
long_description: Instrumentation and Measurement Complex Engineering Problem (CEP) at UET Taxila. An interrupt-driven Arduino sketch samples the Pulse Sensor Amped's PPG signal at 500 Hz, detects heartbeats via an adaptive threshold, and computes BPM from a rolling average of inter-beat intervals, displaying results on a 16x2 I2C LCD and the serial monitor. Verified in Proteus and built on a breadboard; validated against a commercial pulse oximeter across 4 volunteers with 3.2% average error.

title: Boiler Automation System (Steam Flow, Water Flow & Drum Level Control)
short_description: Three-element drum level control for an industrial boiler, implemented as PLC ladder logic with a CX-Designer HMI mimic panel.
long_description: Industrial Automation Complex Engineering Problem (CEP) at UET Taxila. Designs a three-element control scheme (drum level + steam flow + feedwater flow, cascaded) to keep a boiler's water level, steam flow, and feedwater flow within safe limits. Includes sensor selection/comparison (pressure, level, temperature), a P&ID, a process flow chart, Omron CX-Programmer ladder logic for the control sequence, and a CX-Designer HMI operator panel mirroring the same PLC bits.
